text.description_html:
Schlage FC285CEN622BOWCEN, Century Handleset Grip With Century Bowery Knob

This is a customer handleset. It comes packaged with the Schlage Custom Century Handleset Grip and the Bowery Knob with Century Rose Interior Trim. No deadbolt.

Features and Specifications of the Century Handleset with Bowery Knob No Deadbolt:

  • All metal chassis for strength and durability.
  • 3 screw door frame reinforcer.
  • C keyway comes packaged with 2 keys.
  • Outside Trim: Handlesets are solid forged brass; wrought brass trim rings with concealed security inserts.
  • Inside Trim: are zinc-based plated to match finishes indicated.
  • Rage of Door Preparation: 4" to 5-1/2"
  • Exterior Total Height: 17-13/16" (with 5-1/2" door prep)
  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Exterior Center to Center Grip Range: adjustable 8-1/2" to 9-3/4"
  • Exterior Top Grip Escutcheon Width: 2-1/2"
  • Exterior Grip Height: 11-7/8"
  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/10"
  • Interior Rose Height: 4-5/32" (4.15")
  • Interior Rose Width: 2-27/32" (2.84")
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4"

Custom item, NOT Returnable
